content.title: TeraWulf to Raise $3.2 Billion for Google-Backed Data Center. The Stock Is Rising.
content.summary: TeraWulf  the data-center operator best known for its Bitcoin mining facilities, plans to offer $3.2 billion in senior secured notes due in 2030 in a private offering, the company announced Tuesday.  It will use the proceeds to finance a portion of its Lake Mariner data-center campus in upstate New York.  TeraWulf  didn’t immediately respond to requests for further comment.
